LanguageData.LP_StormGiant.label: storm giant
LanguageData.LP_StormGiant.description: A giant race dwelling in the deep sea and at the heart of storms; the bloodline is passed on to children, but they have few. Adult storm giants are 2.4 times the size of an ordinary person, with pale lilac-grey or teal skin, wearing crowns woven of coral and thunder patterns. They walk freely through deep sea and shallows, lightning striking them leaves them unharmed, and every punch carries thunder. Storm giants are born seers, able to read coming disasters in the winds and clouds; this gift also leaves them gloomy all day long. In the giant ordning, storm giants stand at the top.
LanguageData.LP_StormGiant.descriptionShort: Inheritable giant race (rank 1 of the ordning). 2.4× giant body, moving in water, immune to EMP and lightning strikes, melee carries thunder, stronger in wind and rain, foresees raids; lightning bolt, summon storm; fertility ×0.5, gloomy by nature.
